name: Modbus Client → On Sent
description: Fires when the frame is written to the wire. Lambda variable: `request` (`std::span<const uint8_t>`, the PDU sent). This fires once per transmission, before any reply, and does not fire when the send ends in `on_not_sent` (nothing was transmitted). Exactly one of `on_response`/`on_error`/`on_no_response`/`on_not_sent` follows each transmission attempt - a retry reopens this cycle for its own attempt; see [Behavior](https://esphome.io/components/modbus_client#behavior).
